dividers use measured midplanes. Document that choice; do not confuse a face
dimension with a centreline dimension or apply an unobserved half-thickness.
World z is absolute. basis explains observed dimensions and reference planes.

orthogonal partitions; footprint and rooms may be nonrectangular. Trace every
outer turn, including recesses; never fill the bounding rectangle or add walls
to split a continuous space into boxes. Windows on recessed exterior edges are
supported; code derives their outward direction from the calibrated outer ring.
Nonorthogonal rings, holes and ambiguous hosts explicitly fail.
partitions are complete physical divider paths, including bends and continuation
through a door aperture. Put the aperture separately in openings. Shared path
endpoints must coincide explicitly. The compiler will not extend, snap or bridge
paths; record any regularization you apply in basis or assumptions.
Every enclosed face becomes one space. No room count is supplied or enforced.
An open passage still leaves two faces and two spaces, even at full ceiling height.
Use it for an evidenced opening in a real separating wall. A corridor bend or
continuation without a physical separator belongs to ONE face: do not draw a
closing line there just to host a passage. To repair an overextended partition,
update its points to one real wall portion and add the other real portions as
separate paths with coincident actual junctions. Remove any invented opening on
the removed portion in the SAME revision. The compiler then derives the merged
space and its actual opening hosts; do not manually recreate every room polygon.
Optional space_seeds assign IDs/roles to containing faces; every unseeded face is
retained with a stable derived ID and unknown role. Seeds are points INSIDE rooms,
not wall points. Two seeds in one face fail rather than inventing a divider.
The whole opening segment must belong to exactly one exterior host or two
interior hosts. A door spanning a wall junction fails; no width is clipped.
kind is window, door or open. Only exterior facade windows are supported here;
doors/open passages may connect rooms or outdoors. Door state defaults unknown;
its optional state is unknown/open/closed. For open passages state is open or
omitted; window state is not supported. Preserve IDs, source_refs and assumptions.
Empty openings or incomplete observed coverage is allowed ONLY as an explicit
partial draft: record unexamined views and omissions in unresolved. A partial
draft does not establish room completeness or drawing fidelity.
The raw declaration and deterministic mapping are retained in plan_drafts.

use 'resume' for an explicitly supplied saved pixel plan. Pass that hash as

{
  "topic": "claims",
  "reference": "Evidence transactions for drawing counts and existing-candidate parameters.

Use claim_transaction(candidate, entries_json). entries_json is a list; each
entry has claim (a new observation) OR claim_id (an existing one), action,
reason and operations where needed. Entries run in order, using the candidate
returned by the preceding successful apply. Each entry commits independently;
failures keep earlier results and any recorded claim/decision. Read each status
and audit_file. Do not blindly retry a partly completed transaction.
- action=confirm records/adopts and verifies unchanged parameters, without a new BIM.
- action=apply records/adopts and revises using the same operations as revise_bim.
- action=record records/adopts only; action=decide changes an existing decision.
  disposition is adopted (default), deferred or retracted; confirm/apply require adopted.
  An already retracted claim cannot be automatically revived by confirm/apply.
reason explains YOUR evidence-based decision; if omitted it uses the claim's reason.
No decision, applied value or confirmation certifies drawing truth.

Example entries_json (synthetic numbers, NOT a case answer):
[{"claim":{
  "objects":[{"kind":"opening","id":"door_A"}],
  "basis":"annotation_and_pixels",
  "reason":"This door's labelled chain; world origin is 3 m and direction is down.",
  "sources":[{"view_id":"view_0001"}],
  "values":{"height":{"type":"dimension_chain","lengths":[900,1800,300],
    "unit":"mm","origin_m":3.0,"direction":-1,"segment":1}},
  "observation_mode":"candidate_review","unresolved":[]},
 "action":"apply","reason":"Apply this door's observed extent",
 "operations":[{"op":"update_opening","id":"door_A",
   "changes":{"z":{"claim":"$claim","value":"height"}},
   "reason":"Apply the recorded chain"}]}]
A new claim defaults to the current candidate. $claim refers to that entry's ID;
existing IDs also work. Each apply/confirm entry references its own claim; use
separate entries for different claims. Other explicit edits may accompany an
apply; unbound parameters remain recorded as such. The example computes absolute
z=[0.3,2.1]. Transcribe actual labels and explain their datum and physical extent.

Use inspect_candidate/read_candidate_items for exact IDs. Object kinds are
window (geometry.windows), opening (geometry.openings: doors/passages), space,
and boundary (exact source boundary ID). The unified source openings list also
contains windows; their claim kind is still window. Do not alter IDs.

basis: annotation_and_pixels, pixels, visual_estimate, inference or declared.
Image bases require sources. Declared/inferred values may have none; label the
actual basis and unresolved evidence. Sources accept {"view_id":"view_0001"}
from view_image OR {"image":"elevation.png","box":[20,30,100,200]} in original
pixels. Do not combine the forms. Code binds original bytes and view metadata;
whole-image references without box remain unlocalized. View the opening, its
labels and dimension endpoints before adopting. view_image(claim_id=...,
source_index=..., display_scale=1..8) reopens saved crops; indices are zero-based.
Seeing a crop is not OCR or proof of interpretation. observation_mode is direct
or candidate_review, a caller-reported distinction, not independent verification.

Value types:
- literal: {"type":"literal","value":0.18,"unit":"m"}; a scalar or a vector/interval.
- dimension_chain: as above; zero-based segment selects its ordered metre span.
- image_axis: {"type":"image_axis","image":"elevation.png","axis":"y",
  "anchors":[[10,3.0],[210,0.0]],"pixels":[40,180]}.
  Explain which world x/y/z the image axis represents. One pixel gives a scalar;
  two give an ordered interval; reduction="midpoint" gives the two-face midpoint.
  Pixels/anchor pixels may use {"profile":"profile_001","candidate":"C01","at":"start"}
  (also peak/end) from view_pixel_profile. Code checks original image/axis/hash.
  Ink candidates are not automatically physical walls or apertures.
For p1/p2 use a literal [x,y]; an image_axis interval is not a 2D point.

Supported references replace parameter values: update_window.z/span;
update_opening.z/p1/p2; move_shared_wall.coordinate_m (name both spaces);
add_opening.opening.p1/p2/z (name existing host spaces, both for an interior door);
and scalar polygon coordinates in reshape_spaces, e.g.
{"op":"reshape_spaces","spaces":[{"id":"room_A",
 "polygon":[[0,0],[{"claim":"$claim","value":"wall_x"},0],
 [{"claim":"$claim","value":"wall_x"},5],[0,5]]}],"reason":"Measured wall"}.
Keep unaffected coordinates literal, reference every changed occurrence, and
explicitly revise affected openings as usual. Source references are added by code.
Measured endpoints and assumed heights need separate claims; a plan source must
not masquerade as observed height. New identity/kind/connectivity are declarations.
Confirmation supports window/opening, shared-wall and reshape intents; every
confirmed parameter must be bound. A reshape confirmation therefore needs every
coordinate bound; use window/opening intents for ordinary height confirmation.

Optional value_targets maps EVERY value to the subset of declared objects it
supplies, e.g. {"wall_x":[{"kind":"space","id":"room_A"}],"face_interval":[]}.
[] denotes supporting evidence, never an applicable or missing parameter.
Without value_targets, every value targets every object. Do not conflate objects
or floors just because numbers match. Claims and originals remain immutable.
An unmodified target can inherit only along the actual candidate ancestry while
its geometry, physical host, source views and recomputed values remain unchanged.
The return names any changed item; handle unchanged targets separately and
reobserve changed ones. A notes/use-only change can retain physical observations.
A moved-then-restored target is conservatively invalid. No duplicate observation
is needed merely to change the parent hash. A confirmation is still required to
establish that an unapplied value matches the current parameter.

If only a source region is wrong, replace_claim_sources with actual view_ids and
a reason saves a new claim with the same objects/values and retracts the old one.
Adoption/confirmation does not transfer; inspect the new sources and transact its
new claim_id. If the interpretation/values change, record new evidence and use
action=decide, disposition=retracted for the obsolete claim. A wider view alone
does not change a saved narrow source.

For counts before or after BIM, use an entry with action=record and claim:
{"observation_type":"facade_count","image":"elevation.png","floor_id":"L1",
 "facade":"South","window_count":4,"reason":"Synthetic whole-facade count"}.
No candidate, decision or operations is needed for counts. Replace floor_id with
floor_plan_image before building. Optional box gives a source region; door_count
is separate. Include observed zero. Counts cover the WHOLE named floor/facade,
not just a crop. Re-record to correct the same scope; different images are
compared, never summed. facade_counts reports missing/conflicting totals and
unresolved scopes on saves/checks/delivery; matching counts prove no positions.

height_coverage lists evidenced/problem openings; other missing bindings are counted.
Full rows in details_file retain z, status, claim IDs and views.
Location needs that facade's explicit elevation calibration and a source
region containing this opening. A region containing several openings is marked
needs_per_opening_confirmation, even when numbers match; narrow/replace the
source with each opening's own evidence. Internal heights remain in the source
inventory. Status is not proof that a dimension chain was read correctly.

claim_status(candidate) reports confirmed_unchanged, applied_current,
pending_application, partially_satisfied, changed_since_check and decisions,
with missing bindings and unresolved evidence. Other branches stay separate;
imported prior-run applications are inherited/not rechecked. claim_status()
returns history. A failed edit keeps its parent and audit; a failed source
candidate may remain for inspection. Unbound geometry is untracked, not thereby
wrong. finish_bim preserves execution failures and adopted-but-unapplied evidence.

- action=record records/adopts only; action=decide changes an existing decision.
  disposition is adopted (default), deferred or retracted; confirm/apply require adopted.
  An already retracted claim cannot be automatically revived by confirm/apply.
reason explains YOUR evidence-based decision; if omitted it uses the claim's reason.
No decision, applied value or confirmation certifies drawing truth.

Example entries_json (synthetic numbers, NOT a case answer):
[{"claim":{
  "objects":[{"kind":"opening","id":"door_A"}],
  "basis":"annotation_and_pixels",
  "reason":"This door's labelled chain; world origin is 3 m and direction is down.",
  "sources":[{"view_id":"view_0001"}],
  "values":{"height":{"type":"dimension_chain","lengths":[900,1800,300],
    "unit":"mm","origin_m":3.0,"direction":-1,"segment":1}},
  "observation_mode":"candidate_review","unresolved":[]},
 "action":"apply","reason":"Apply this door's observed extent",
 "operations":[{"op":"update_opening","id":"door_A",
   "changes":{"z":{"claim":"$claim","value":"height"}},
   "reason":"Apply the recorded chain"}]}]
A new claim defaults to the current candidate. $claim refers to that entry's ID;
existing IDs also work. Each apply/confirm entry references its own claim; use
separate entries for different claims. Other explicit edits may accompany an
apply; unbound parameters remain recorded as such. The example computes absolute
z=[0.3,2.1]. Transcribe actual labels and explain their datum and physical extent.

Use inspect_candidate/read_candidate_items for exact IDs. Object kinds are
window (geometry.windows), opening (geometry.openings: doors/passages), space,
and boundary (exact source boundary ID). The unified source openings list also
contains windows; their claim kind is still window. Do not alter IDs.

basis: annotation_and_pixels, pixels, visual_estimate, inference or declared.
Image bases require sources. Declared/inferred values may have none; label the
actual basis and unresolved evidence. Sources accept {"view_id":"view_0001"}
from view_image OR {"image":"elevation.png","box":[20,30,100,200]} in original
pixels. Do not combine the forms. Code binds original bytes and view metadata;
whole-image references without box remain unlocalized. View the opening, its
labels and dimension endpoints before adopting. view_image(claim_id=...,
source_index=..., display_scale=1..8) reopens saved crops; indices are zero-based.
Seeing a crop is not OCR or proof of interpretation. observation_mode is direct
or candidate_review, a caller-reported distinction, not independent verification.

Value types:
- literal: {"type":"literal","value":0.18,"unit":"m"}; a scalar or a vector/interval.
- dimension_chain: as above; zero-based segment selects its ordered metre span.
- image_axis: {"type":"image_axis","image":"elevation.png","axis":"y",
  "anchors":[[10,3.0],[210,0.0]],"pixels":[40,180]}.
  Explain which world x/y/z the image axis represents. One pixel gives a scalar;
  two give an ordered interval; reduction="midpoint" gives the two-face midpoint.
  Pixels/anchor pixels may use {"profile":"profile_001","candidate":"C01","at":"start"}
  (also peak/end) from view_pixel_profile. Code checks original image/axis/hash.
  Ink candidates are not automatically physical walls or apertures.
For p1/p2 use a literal [x,y]; an image_axis interval is not a 2D point.

Supported references replace parameter values: update_window.z/span;
update_opening.z/p1/p2; move_shared_wall.coordinate_m (name both spaces);
add_opening.opening.p1/p2/z (name existing host spaces, both for an interior door);
and scalar polygon coordinates in reshape_spaces, e.g.
{"op":"reshape_spaces","spaces":[{"id":"room_A",
 "polygon":[[0,0],[{"claim":"$claim","value":"wall_x"},0],
 [{"claim":"$claim","value":"wall_x"},5],[0,5]]}],"reason":"Measured wall"}.
Keep unaffected coordinates literal, reference every changed occurrence, and
explicitly revise affected openings as usual. Source references are added by code.
Measured endpoints and assumed heights need separate claims; a plan source must
not masquerade as observed height. New identity/kind/connectivity are declarations.
Confirmation supports window/opening, shared-wall and reshape intents; every
confirmed parameter must be bound. A reshape confirmation therefore needs every
coordinate bound; use window/opening intents for ordinary height confirmation.

Optional value_targets maps EVERY value to the subset of declared objects it
supplies, e.g. {"wall_x":[{"kind":"space","id":"room_A"}],"face_interval":[]}.
[] denotes supporting evidence, never an applicable or missing parameter.
Without value_targets, every value targets every object. Do not conflate objects
or floors just because numbers match. Claims and originals remain immutable.
An unmodified target can inherit only along the actual candidate ancestry while
its geometry, physical host, source views and recomputed values remain unchanged.
The return names any changed item; handle unchanged targets separately and
reobserve changed ones. A notes/use-only change can retain physical observations.
A moved-then-restored target is conservatively invalid. No duplicate observation
is needed merely to change the parent hash. A confirmation is still required to
establish that an unapplied value matches the current parameter.

If only a source region is wrong, replace_claim_sources with actual view_ids and
a reason saves a new claim with the same objects/values and retracts the old one.
Adoption/confirmation does not transfer; inspect the new sources and transact its
new claim_id. If the interpretation/values change, record new evidence and use
action=decide, disposition=retracted for the obsolete claim. A wider view alone
does not change a saved narrow source.

not just a crop. Re-record to correct the same scope; different images are

unresolved scopes on saves/checks/delivery; matching counts prove no positions.

height_coverage lists evidenced/problem openings; other missing bindings are counted.
Full rows in details_file retain z, status, claim IDs and views.
Location needs that facade's explicit elevation calibration and a source
region containing this opening. A region containing several openings is marked
needs_per_opening_confirmation, even when numbers match; narrow/replace the
source with each opening's own evidence. Internal heights remain in the source
inventory. Status is not proof that a dimension chain was read correctly.

claim_status(candidate) reports confirmed_unchanged, applied_current,
pending_application, partially_satisfied, changed_since_check and decisions,
with missing bindings and unresolved evidence. Other branches stay separate;
imported prior-run applications are inherited/not rechecked. claim_status()
returns history. A failed edit keeps its parent and audit; a failed source
candidate may remain for inspection. Unbound geometry is untracked, not thereby

All 14 height claims applied → candidate_15. z values: windows [1,2.8] / [1,3.4], doors [0.2,2.6] ✓ bound via applications.

But height_coverage says "missing"/"no_elevation_calibration" — the located status requires "that facade's explicit elevation calibration". The claims are applied with evidence but location lacks elevation calibration. The delivery requirement: "exterior opening heights observed on the elevations are saved as located claims confirmed or applied on the delivered candidate". They are applied claims with per-opening source regions ✓. The "located" status in height_coverage needs elevation calibration — I could provide elevation calibration via view_elevation_candidate with horizontal_anchors and z_anchors per facade. That would make claims "located". It also returns overlays comparing source elevation with original — good verification of facade correspondence!

Doing 4 view_elevation_candidate calls (N, S, E, W) with calibration would (a) visually verify each facade's opening positions/sizes against the source, and (b) register elevation calibrations so height_coverage becomes located.

Calibration per facade:
North: horizontal = world x, mirrored (left = east). Image x: window left edge... The plan: window W-N1 at x 4.66..9.46. In North_view, window at px 390..840 (original px; from view_0002: window x 390..840). Mapping: world x = 10 - (px_x - px0)*s. Compute anchors: use the door/window edges. Door D-N-entry at x 0.54..2.14 → in image at px 1073..1220. So px 1073 ↔ world x 2.14, px 1220 ↔ 0.54: s = (2.14-0.54)/(1220-1073)= 1.6/147 = 0.010885 m/px. Check window: px 390 ↔ x = 2.14 + (1073-390)*0.010885 = 2.14+7.43=9.57? Expected 9.46. Hmm ~0.11 off. px 840 ↔ 2.14+2.53=4.67 ≈ 4.66 ✓ left edge matches; right edge 390 → 9.57 vs 9.46 — off by 0.11m (10px). Hmm, measurement error in my pixel reads. Let me instead use view_elevation_candidate with anchors and see the overlay; adjust if needed.

Better anchors from the elevation image: the overall width chain: left dimension line at px 340 (10000 start) and right at 1270. So px 340 ↔ world x=10 (east corner), px 1270 ↔ x=0. s = 10/930 = 0.010753. Check door: x 0.54 → px 1270-0.54/0.010753=1220 ✓; x 2.14 → px 1071 ✓. Window 4.66..9.46 → px 836.6..390.2 ✓ matches observed 390..840!

z anchors: ground line at py≈637 (z=0), wall top at py≈220 (z=4.5). From view_0002: top of wall y≈220, ground y≈637. s = 4.5/417 = 0.010791 m/px. limits: Caller selects the image/facade and original-pixel/world-metre references; neither is independently verified.
Horizontal values are world x/y, not distance from the facade's left edge; z is absolute, not above-floor height.
Only axis-aligned drawings are supported; no rotation, perspective or automatic pixel matching.
All same-facing exterior hosts are projected; recess-depth occlusion is not resolved.

The reference background is grayscale; consult the original colour drawing for colour conventions. All projected geometry is coloured: cyan wall edges, green floor datum lines, orange windows, purple doors/open passages.
Cyan wall edges include per-space segmentation; these edges do not establish visible joints in the original facade.
IDs use clear side regions; labels may be omitted on busy images. Leaders skip existing ink. IDs remain in the opening inventory.
No source geometry is changed. Repeat with the same observed anchors after revision; do not fit anchors to generated openings.

content.text:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Reconstruct "one inspectable lightweight BIM of the whole building shown in the supplied original plans and elevations". This is an original-image-only run: no saved plans, generated BIM, prior observations, calibration, reference counts, target heights or GT are supplied. Use build_plan_bim for each distinct floor and assemble_plan_bim only if several floors exist (do not invent a floor). Delivery requirements in order: (1) delivered candidate has every drawn wall, space, door and window of each floor where the drawings put it, checked against the originals, remaining differences stated with reasons; (2) exterior opening heights observed on elevations saved as located claims confirmed or applied on the delivered candidate, distinct from assumptions; unobserved internal door heights may remain explicit assumptions; (3) delivered candidate's saved notes match its actual state. Report what was observed, assumed, left unverified. Constraints: work directly with deterministic and visual tools, no review_detail or delegation; budget 6000 seconds; no EnergyPlus objects or materials; never move/shorten/delete/relabel observed openings; keep observed/inferred/assumed distinct; finish with finish_bim(candidate) and state the selected candidate. Start by listing supplied inputs.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - BIM agent toolset: view_image (crops, display_scale, view_id), view_pixel_profile (gray-fill wall band detection, profile candidates C01..), build_plan_bim (plan_partition JSON: x_anchors/y_anchors calibration, footprint_pixels, partitions as complete paths through door apertures, openings with p1/p2 px + z, space_seeds with roles), revise_plan_bim (draft_id + expected_plan_sha256 + operations update/add/remove), view_elevation_candidate (facade calibration via horizontal_anchors/z_anchors; registers elevation calibration so height_coverage becomes "located"), claim_transaction (facade_count records; claims with objects/sources/values dimension_chain; action=apply with operations needing their own "reason"), drawing_differences, height_coverage, facade_counts, room_types catalog (office, conference/meeting/multipurpose, corridor, storage…).
   - Dimension-chain reading: chains read from wall top (z=4.5) downward: {"type":"dimension_chain","lengths":[...],"unit":"mm","origin_m":4.5,"direction":-1,"segment":1}; ordinary windows 1700+1800+1000 → z [1.0,2.8]; large 4800 windows 1100+2400+1000 → z [1.0,3.4]; exterior doors 1900+2400+200 → z [0.2,2.6].
   - Elevation orientations: North view left=east (world x decreases rightward); South left=west (+x); East left=south (+y); West left=north (−y).
   - Plan calibration: 27.47 mm/px both axes; north up; py = 878.5 − y_m/0.027473.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - Inputs: 1f_view.png (790×1111, plan), North_view.png (2890×1651), South_view.png (2434×1457), East_view.png (2639×931), West_view.png (2580×993).
   - Calibration (draft/candidate_01): x_anchors [[248,0],[612,10]], y_anchors [[878.5,0],[150.5,20]]; footprint_pixels [[248,878.5],[612,878.5],[612,150.5],[248,150.5]]; z_floor 0, ceiling_height 4.5.

   - 21 openings (id | px p1–p2 | z m): D-N-entry [267.7,150.5]-[325.9,150.5] z[0.2,2.6]; W-N1 [417.6,150.5]-[592.6,150.5] z[1,3.4]; W-S1 [267.7,878.5]-[322.2,878.5] z[1,2.8]; D-S [413.2,878.5]-[446.1,878.5] z[0.2,2.6]; W-S2 [538.5,878.5]-[592.6,878.5] z[1,2.8]; W-W1 [248,169.9]-[248,224.5] z[1,2.8]; W-W2 [248,312]-[248,355] z[1,2.8]; W-W3 [248,418.3]-[248,473] z[1,2.8]; W-W4 [248,517.3]-[248,571.9] z[1,2.8]; W-W5 [248,683.9]-[248,858.8] z[1,3.4]; W-E1 [612,169.9]-[612,224.5] z[1,2.8]; W-E2 [612,312]-[612,355] z[1,2.8]; W-E3 [612,381.8]-[612,556.5] z[1,3.4]; D-E [612,612.8]-[612,671] z[0.2,2.6]; interior (z[0,2.1] assumed): D-B1 [408,298.5]-[452,298.5]; D-L1 [401,358]-[401,392]; D-L2 [401,420]-[401,453]; D-CONF [401,600]-[401,632]; D-R2 [456.5,325]-[456.5,357]; D-R3 [456.5,380]-[456.5,412]; D-BR [560.5,700]-[589.5,700].

4. Errors and fixes:
   - claim_transaction facade_count failures (3 attempts): (a) entries need wrapper {claim, action, reason}; (b) "unknown input image filename None" → need "image" key; (c) "give exactly one of floor_id or floor_plan_image" → fixed by including both "image":"1f_view.png" and "floor_plan_image":"1f_view.png" in the claim object (transaction_0004 succeeded).
   - build_plan_bim draft_001 compile error: "partitions wall-x458 and wall-E overlap at LINESTRING (456.5 700, 456.5 753.5)" → wall-x458 was wrongly declared down to py 753.5; drawing_differences also showed wall-x458 has no ink at y_px 588–695 (corroborated by view_0016 crop [440,555,630,715]: no wall at px456–462 between the lobby walls) → revised wall-x458 to end at wall-A (py 585.5); wall-E keeps the L (its vertical stub py 700–753.5 is the real ink).
   - drawing_differences "opening_offset_from_gap" for D-B1: declared px 402–456 vs ink gap 410–449 → 8× view_0017 (crop [372,269,486,328]) showed leaf hinges at px≈408 and ≈452 → D-B1 set to [408,298.5]-[452,298.5] (width 1.209 m). After revision draft_002 reported 0 differences.
   - transaction_0005 apply failures: "update_window: reason must be a nonblank string" — each operation object needs its own "reason" (and source_refs) → transaction_0006 re-applied all 14 using claim_id references plus operations with reason/source_refs; all applied.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Resolved full interior topology from plan: north room full-width (y 15.93–20); west column rooms split at y 12.99 (NW meeting) and y 8.05 (W office; SW conference y 0–8.05); corridor x 4.20–5.73 from wall-B to lobby; corridor east wall only wall-B→wall-A; lobby open to corridor, east entry door D-E at y 5.70–7.30 into lobby; wall-D (y 4.90) with door D-BR into SE office; L-shaped wall-E closes corridor south end (y 3.43); NE cabinet room (y 14.24–15.93) and E meeting room (y 8.05–14.24) off corridor via doors D-R2/D-R3; SE office + south vestibule form one connected L-space with door D-S.
   - Verified all exterior opening pixel positions against chains (all within ~3 px) via 4 view_pixel_profile runs on wall bands.
   - Confirmed via 14 applied claims that all exterior z values derive from per-facade dimension chains; height_coverage still "missing"/"no_elevation_calibration" pending facade calibrations (North+South now registered).

6. All user messages:
   - Initial task message: "Scope: Reconstruct one inspectable lightweight BIM of the whole building shown in the supplied original plans and elevations. This is an original-image-only run... Use build_plan_bim for each distinct floor and, if there are several, assemble_plan_bim; do not invent a floor merely to use assembly. Delivery requirements, in order: (1) the delivered candidate has every drawn wall, space, door and window of each floor where the drawings put it, checked against the originals, with any remaining difference stated with its reason; (2) exterior opening heights observed on the elevations are saved as located claims confirmed or applied on the delivered candidate, distinct from assumptions; unobserved internal door heights may remain explicit assumptions; (3) the delivered candidate's saved notes match its actual state. Report what was observed, assumed and left unverified. Experiment constraints: work directly with the deterministic and visual tools, without review_detail or other delegation. Budget: 6000 seconds. Start by listing supplied inputs. No structured building declaration was supplied for this experiment. No saved proposal is supplied; work from the original inputs. Report limitations honestly, and finish within the budget."
   - (Current) summary/compaction request — text only, no tools.

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Register East and West elevation calibrations via view_elevation_candidate on candidate_15 (anchors listed above) and visually confirm projected openings align with originals (so height_coverage becomes located for all 14 exterior openings).
   - Assign room uses via revise_bim set_space_role for all 8 spaces (basis "inferred", with assumptions and source_refs), since room_use_review shows 8 unrecorded roles.
   - Ensure saved notes match state (agent_assumptions currently list interior door heights assumed 0–2.1 m, midplane partitions, inferred uses, deterministic compile; unresolved lists door swing not modelled and caller calibration unverified) — update via replace_note if anything becomes obsolete.

{
  "topic": "claims",
  "reference": "Evidence transactions for drawing counts and existing-candidate parameters.

Use claim_transaction(candidate, entries_json). entries_json is a list; each
entry has claim (a new observation) OR claim_id (an existing one), action,
reason and operations where needed. Entries run in order, using the candidate
returned by the preceding successful apply. Each entry commits independently;
failures keep earlier results and any recorded claim/decision. Read each status
and audit_file. Do not blindly retry a partly completed transaction.
- action=confirm records/adopts and verifies unchanged parameters, without a new BIM.
- action=apply records/adopts and revises using the same operations as revise_bim.
- action=record records/adopts only; action=decide changes an existing decision.
  disposition is adopted (default), deferred or retracted; confirm/apply require adopted.
  An already retracted claim cannot be automatically revived by confirm/apply.
reason explains YOUR evidence-based decision; if omitted it uses the claim's reason.
No decision, applied value or confirmation certifies drawing truth.

Example entries_json (synthetic numbers, NOT a case answer):
[{"claim":{
  "objects":[{"kind":"opening","id":"door_A"}],
  "basis":"annotation_and_pixels",
  "reason":"This door's labelled chain; world origin is 3 m and direction is down.",
  "sources":[{"view_id":"view_0001"}],
  "values":{"height":{"type":"dimension_chain","lengths":[900,1800,300],
    "unit":"mm","origin_m":3.0,"direction":-1,"segment":1}},
  "observation_mode":"candidate_review","unresolved":[]},
 "action":"apply","reason":"Apply this door's observed extent",
 "operations":[{"op":"update_opening","id":"door_A",
   "changes":{"z":{"claim":"$claim","value":"height"}},
   "reason":"Apply the recorded chain"}]}]
A new claim defaults to the current candidate. $claim refers to that entry's ID;
existing IDs also work. Each apply/confirm entry references its own claim; use
separate entries for different claims. Other explicit edits may accompany an
apply; unbound parameters remain recorded as such. The example computes absolute
z=[0.3,2.1]. Transcribe actual labels and explain their datum and physical extent.

Use inspect_candidate/read_candidate_items for exact IDs. Object kinds are
window (geometry.windows), opening (geometry.openings: doors/passages), space,
and boundary (exact source boundary ID). The unified source openings list also
contains windows; their claim kind is still window. Do not alter IDs.

basis: annotation_and_pixels, pixels, visual_estimate, inference or declared.
Image bases require sources. Declared/inferred values may have none; label the
actual basis and unresolved evidence. Sources accept {"view_id":"view_0001"}
from view_image OR {"image":"elevation.png","box":[20,30,100,200]} in original
pixels. Do not combine the forms. Code binds original bytes and view metadata;
whole-image references without box remain unlocalized. View the opening, its
labels and dimension endpoints before adopting. view_image(claim_id=...,
source_index=..., display_scale=1..8) reopens saved crops; indices are zero-based.
Seeing a crop is not OCR or proof of interpretation. observation_mode is direct
or candidate_review, a caller-reported distinction, not independent verification.

Value types:
- literal: {"type":"literal","value":0.18,"unit":"m"}; a scalar or a vector/interval.
- dimension_chain: as above; zero-based segment selects its ordered metre span.
- image_axis: {"type":"image_axis","image":"elevation.png","axis":"y",
  "anchors":[[10,3.0],[210,0.0]],"pixels":[40,180]}.
  Explain which world x/y/z the image axis represents. One pixel gives a scalar;
  two give an ordered interval; reduction="midpoint" gives the two-face midpoint.
  Pixels/anchor pixels may use {"profile":"profile_001","candidate":"C01","at":"start"}
  (also peak/end) from view_pixel_profile. Code checks original image/axis/hash.
  Ink candidates are not automatically physical walls or apertures.
For p1/p2 use a literal [x,y]; an image_axis interval is not a 2D point.

Supported references replace parameter values: update_window.z/span;
update_opening.z/p1/p2; move_shared_wall.coordinate_m (name both spaces);
add_opening.opening.p1/p2/z (name existing host spaces, both for an interior door);
and scalar polygon coordinates in reshape_spaces, e.g.
{"op":"reshape_spaces","spaces":[{"id":"room_A",
 "polygon":[[0,0],[{"claim":"$claim","value":"wall_x"},0],
 [{"claim":"$claim","value":"wall_x"},5],[0,5]]}],"reason":"Measured wall"}.
Keep unaffected coordinates literal, reference every changed occurrence, and
explicitly revise affected openings as usual. Source references are added by code.
Measured endpoints and assumed heights need separate claims; a plan source must
not masquerade as observed height. New identity/kind/connectivity are declarations.
Confirmation supports window/opening, shared-wall and reshape intents; every
confirmed parameter must be bound. A reshape confirmation therefore needs every
coordinate bound; use window/opening intents for ordinary height confirmation.

Optional value_targets maps EVERY value to the subset of declared objects it
supplies, e.g. {"wall_x":[{"kind":"space","id":"room_A"}],"face_interval":[]}.
[] denotes supporting evidence, never an applicable or missing parameter.
Without value_targets, every value targets every object. Do not conflate objects
or floors just because numbers match. Claims and originals remain immutable.
An unmodified target can inherit only along the actual candidate ancestry while
its geometry, physical host, source views and recomputed values remain unchanged.
The return names any changed item; handle unchanged targets separately and
reobserve changed ones. A notes/use-only change can retain physical observations.
A moved-then-restored target is conservatively invalid. No duplicate observation
is needed merely to change the parent hash. A confirmation is still required to
establish that an unapplied value matches the current parameter.

If only a source region is wrong, replace_claim_sources with actual view_ids and
a reason saves a new claim with the same objects/values and retracts the old one.
Adoption/confirmation does not transfer; inspect the new sources and transact its
new claim_id. If the interpretation/values change, record new evidence and use
action=decide, disposition=retracted for the obsolete claim. A wider view alone
does not change a saved narrow source.

For counts before or after BIM, use an entry with action=record and claim:
{"observation_type":"facade_count","image":"elevation.png","floor_id":"L1",
 "facade":"South","window_count":4,"reason":"Synthetic whole-facade count"}.
No candidate, decision or operations is needed for counts. Replace floor_id with
floor_plan_image before building. Optional box gives a source region; door_count
is separate. Include observed zero. Counts cover the WHOLE named floor/facade,
not just a crop. Re-record to correct the same scope; different images are
compared, never summed. facade_counts reports missing/conflicting totals and
unresolved scopes on saves/checks/delivery; matching counts prove no positions.

height_coverage lists evidenced/problem openings; other missing bindings are counted.
Full rows in details_file retain z, status, claim IDs and views.
Location needs that facade's explicit elevation calibration and a source
region containing this opening. A region containing several openings is marked
needs_per_opening_confirmation, even when numbers match; narrow/replace the
source with each opening's own evidence. Internal heights remain in the source
inventory. Status is not proof that a dimension chain was read correctly.

claim_status(candidate) reports confirmed_unchanged, applied_current,
pending_application, partially_satisfied, changed_since_check and decisions,
with missing bindings and unresolved evidence. Other branches stay separate;
imported prior-run applications are inherited/not rechecked. claim_status()
returns history. A failed edit keeps its parent and audit; a failed source
candidate may remain for inspection. Unbound geometry is untracked, not thereby
wrong. finish_bim preserves execution failures and adopted-but-unapplied evidence.
",
  "remaining_seconds": 4452
}

## Building reconstructed
Single storey, 10 m (x, west–east) × 20 m (y, south–north), floor z=0, ceiling 4.5 m. 8 spaces, 54 boundaries, 21 openings, 10 door connections:

- **Spaces**: N-room (full-width north, y 15.93–20), NW-meeting (y 12.99–15.93), W-office (y 8.05–12.99), SW-conference (y 0–8.05) down the west side; corridor-lobby spine (x 4.20–5.73) from the north wall to the L-shaped wall-E closure at y 3.43, opening east into the lobby; NE-cabinet (1.69 m deep), E-meeting (y 8.05–14.24) and SE-office (L-shaped, with the south vestibule) on the east side.
- **Doors**: 3 exterior — D-N-entry, D-S, D-E (all 1.6 m, z 0.2–2.6). 7 interior — D-B1, D-L1, D-L2, D-CONF, D-R2, D-R3, D-BR (assumed z 0–2.1).
- **Windows**: 11 — four 4800 mm (W-N1, W-E3, W-W5, z 1–3.4), six 1500 mm and one 1180 mm (z 1–2.8), each on its observed wall.

## Observed
- All walls and dividers from the plan's drawn line pairs; every opening placed from its own jamb/frame marks and dimension segments (plan calibration 27.47 mm/px from the 10000/20000 chains; draft_002 ended with 0 drawing_differences after the wall-x458 and D-B1 corrections).
- All 14 exterior opening heights read from per-facade dimension chains on the four elevations (ordinary windows 1700+1800+1000; large windows 1100+2400+1000; doors 1900+2400+200 from the 4500 wall top). All 14 are **located claims** on the delivered candidate: 5 applied (North/South) and 9 confirmed with per-opening elevation crops under registered East/West calibrations; calibrated overlays align projected openings with the drawn ink on all four facades. Facade window counts match observations (N 1, S 2, E 3, W 5).

## Assumed (explicit in saved notes)
- Interior door heights 0–2.1 m (no interior elevation supplied).
- Interior partitions on line-pair midplanes; drawn 240 mm thicknesses not modelled.
- All 8 room uses inferred (no printed labels): office ×3, meeting/conference ×3, corridor, storage (NE-cabinet).

## Left unexamined / limitations
- Door swing directions visible in the plan but leaf state not modelled.
- All pixel-to-world and elevation calibrations are caller-supplied arithmetic, not independently verified; a returned image is not proof of correct interpretation.
- "distinct_width_on_facade" informational flags on W-E3/W-W5 (each has its own chain, so no height transfer was involved); drawing fidelity formally "not_evaluated" by the tooling, differences were resolved manually to 0 on the final draft.
